I made the "Nothing to save" artboard (D) calmer. The canvas check passes and the screenshot shows the new layout. The screenshots came out very small, though, so I could only confirm the overall arrangement. I couldn't see whether the green check is still clearly visible now that it's smaller and paler. I tried to enlarge the image to look closer, but that needed approval, which can't be given in this session.

**Smaller illustration** (`.design/ui/GitPanel.tsx:349`)
- The Maude mark went from 40 to 24 px and is now more transparent (60% instead of 90%).
- The green check circle went from 52 to 36 px, with the check icon from 26 to 18 px. Its green background is a bit paler.

**More white space** (`.design/ui/GitPanel.css`, the empty-state styles only)
- There's now a 24 px gap between the illustration and the heading, and between the text and the View History button.
- The side padding is wider. The bottom padding is doubled, so the group sits slightly above the middle of the panel.
- The body text has more space between lines.

The styles I changed are only used by this artboard, and the text and button are unchanged. Another AI run was active but hadn't started on any artboard, so it didn't affect this one. The check flagged a fixed `font-weight: 600` on the heading. That was there before and I left it alone.
